title: Judge Holds Off on Immediate Ruling on White House’s Media Ban
summary: Judge Timothy J. Kelly heard arguments about President Trump’s recent decision to bar CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House grounds. He said he would issue a decision about it “as soon as possible.”
